body.title: Pipeline core: bounded gather
body.summary: Add the gather to the pipeline core: obligation calls; level-by-level reduction under the quarter-limit note cap, with the job keeping which atoms and earlier notes each note stands for; relationCall returning one or more calls, counted under pipelineCalls.relation; merge; and result.
acceptanceChecks: An obligation whose evidence exceeds the limit is reduced level by level, every gather call fits, and provenance is kept.
A relation judged by two calls is complete only when both are answered.
